name: Palestine
overview: The Scriptures reveal God's sovereign promise to Abraham and his descendants regarding the land of Canaan, which encompasses the region historically known as Palestine. This promise includes specific geographic boundaries from the river of Egypt to the Euphrates River, as God assured Abram that his seed would inherit this land (Genesis 15:18). The Lord directed His people to possess the land by driving out its inhabitants, establishing His covenantal claim and purpose for Israel in this territory (Exodus 23:31; Deuteronomy 1:7). Thus, the biblical narrative centers on God's faithful fulfillment of His covenant through the possession and settlement of the land He designated for His chosen people.
